scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n server,extension -c auto "npm run dev -w @deep-reader/server" "npm run dev -w @deep-reader/chrome-extension"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run extension:permissions:check
scripts.e2e:extension:live: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @deep-reader/server && npm run build -w @deep-reader/chrome-extension && node scripts/run-extension-e2e.mjs e2e/chrome-extension-live.mjs
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @deep-reader/shared && npm run build -w @deep-reader/visualization
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @deep-reader/server && npm run build -w @deep-reader/chrome-extension
scripts.e2e:extension:real: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @deep-reader/server && npm run build -w @deep-reader/chrome-extension && node scripts/run-extension-e2e.mjs e2e/chrome-extension-real-pdf-smoke.mjs
scripts.e2e:extension:native-startup: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @deep-reader/server && npm run build -w @deep-reader/chrome-extension && node scripts/native-host-manager.mjs install && node scripts/run-extension-e2e.mjs e2e/chrome-extension-native-startup.mjs
scripts.native-host:install: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @deep-reader/server && npm run build -w @deep-reader/chrome-extension && node scripts/native-host-manager.mjs install
